entries.01687ac71a31c336: The [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual Securities Report]] states that the group consists of the company, Toyota Motor Corporation (other affiliated company), 17 consolidated subsidiaries, 1 unconsolidated subsidiary and 3 affiliates, and that its main business is the manufacture and sale of steel products (special steel and stainless steel), forgings, electronic functional materials and components, and magnet application products. Its products are centered on automobiles, and [Business and Other Risks] in the Annual Securities Report states that the main customers for its core steel products and forgings are in the automotive industry. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥304,341 million: Forging Company ¥134,823 million, Steel Company ¥105,567 million, Stainless Steel Company ¥38,897 million, Smart Company ¥22,107 million, and other businesses ¥2,945 million. As of March 31, 2026, Toyota Motor Corporation held 24.7% of the company's voting rights (including indirect ownership), and the Annual Securities Report states that dependence on Toyota Motor Corporation and the Toyota Group is very high.

entries.6a3768fd156e4a35: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells electronic functional materials and components, magnet application products, plant activation materials and metal fibers. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥22,107 million (up 7.4% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥1,375 million. The main products of electronic functional materials and components are electronic components such as in-vehicle heat dissipation parts made with advanced plating technology, and the amorphous MI sensor, an ultra-compact, ultra-high-sensitivity magnetic sensor. The main products of magnet application products are denture attachments for the medical market and neodymium anisotropic bonded magnets for the automotive and home appliance markets. The securities report states that revenue increased because of higher sales of electronic components.

entries.72b87567b564bc02: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥304,341 million, up 1.7% from the previous year (¥299,287 million). entries.7ac6e4dab0f0f9b1: The company and 17 consolidated subsidiaries, among others, manufacture and sell special steel, stainless steel, forgings and electronic functional materials and components. Consolidated headcount was 4,427 (as of March 31, 2026; the average number of temporary employees was 796), expenditure on research and development activities was ¥5,164 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, and there were about 250 research and development personnel.
